--- grant_execute_on_all_functions_in_default_schema.sql
GRANT EXECUTE ON ALL FUNCTIONS IN SCHEMA DEFAULT TO ROLE consumer

--- AST
&ast.Grant{
  Privilege: &ast.ExecutePrivilegeOnAllFunctionsInSchema{
    Execute: 6,
    Table:   -1,
    Default: 41,
  },
  Roles: []*ast.Ident{
    &ast.Ident{
      NamePos: 57,
      NameEnd: 65,
      Name:    "consumer",
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
GRANT EXECUTE ON ALL FUNCTIONS IN SCHEMA DEFAULT TO ROLE consumer
